headline: Anthropic IPO Valuation and Stock Volatility Spark AI Scrutiny
summary: Anthropic shares dropped below their $83 IPO price before rebounding, intensifying investor scrutiny over high technology valuations and the profit-generation capacity of AI leaders.
why: Valuation corrections in major artificial intelligence firms impact broader technology sector sentiment and investor risk appetite in equity markets.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Trading fluctuations below and above the initial offering price reflect intense market debate over AI valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Questions surrounding whether AI beneficiaries can generate enough profit to justify their share prices triggered initial selling pressure before bargain hunters stepped in.
